sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Roll when a PC does something uncertain and consequences matter.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use for proactive PC action under pressure.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Player states the action in the fiction.
GM names the trait that best matches the method and the Difficulty.
Player rolls Hope d12 + Fear d12 and adds trait, Experience, or advantage/disadvantage.
Compare total to Difficulty, then resolve the Hope/Fear or critical result.

sections.title: Try it
sections.body: Give a player Presence 12 to calm a worried animal, then ask what Hope or Fear changes in the scene.

sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: Roll when a PC does something uncertain and consequences matter.
When: Use for proactive PC action under pressure.
Not When: Do not roll when success is obvious or failure would not change anything.
Answer: Tell me what you do, then we choose the trait that fits.
Example: Searching Tamsin's cart is an Action Roll because the result changes what the party learns.
Aliases: roll check skill check action rolls
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
